summary: 29 units reviewed: 26 fix, 3 ok. 1 error, 38 minor; all but five advisory items carry machine patches; no regrouping suggested. Tokens, splits, cases, roots and compound types are sound; the one real error is unit 8, where the draft flags pākva.māṃsika as a typo for pakva-: pākva-māṃsika is the regular -ika taddhita of the compound pakva-māṃsa with initial vṛddhi (like audanika, āpūpika beside it), so the flag is removed and w restored to the printed form. The other four text flags are right (grāmeṣu, rasa.siddhaṃ, daṇḍa; vikrayeṇa plausible and honestly marked 'possible'). Unit 9 needs a text flag the draft lacks (printed gṛhītā for gṛhītāḥ before striyaḥ, silently corrected in w). Unit 28: w ādīpta-āvāsān should be the unsandhied ablative ādīpta-āvāsāt that the draft itself reads. Unit 25: five-member compound labelled dvandva loc. sg. is a bahuvrīhi. The recurring problem is bracketed glosses and insertions inside the Hindi of 25 units (1-8, 10-12, 14, 15, 18-29); patches supply bracket-free Hindi, with gūḍha-puruṣa = गूढ़ पुरुष made consistent. Small additions removed: 'पहले' (6), 'के बहाने' (8), the English paraphrase of moha-sthāneṣu (14). Checked as asked and left as drafted (honest notes, no firm reading): 12.4.1 paṇya-āgāra-pūrvam (I think 'with a shop set up first' is likelier than 'gifts of goods and dwellings'; a person should choose), 12.4.4 naiṣecanikam and 12.4.5 pādyam, 12.4.8 auṇḍika and kālikam ('on credit' vs 'for the occasion'), 12.4.23 (eva?) mark, sattra and stambha-vāṭa, 12.4.25 khañjana, 12.4.28 nidhāna-gata, 12.4.29 yoga-vāmana-yoga (low confidence is right). Existing glossary renderings applied (vaidehaka = trader, āṭavika = forest chieftain, aparuddha = prince in disfavour, pratyanta-skandha = frontier contingent; units 1, 11, 19, 20). Glossary extended with gūḍha-puruṣa, abhityakta, avaskanda, yoga in Book 12 and madana.
